the source-pad field sits over the tile footprint (the pad model's own geometric capacity), so 1 V leaves the package directly above each cell; the in-tile collection is owned by P_intraVR_metal (R2 output plane) and the lateral spreading beyond the tile happens in the die's power grid, outside package scope. ALTERNATIVE, quantified: if the pad field were spread over the whole cell pitch, a 10 um / 80 % plane would carry the spreading at 0.3018 W per rail (lv_alternative_r_ohm, periodic unit cell)
